question.en: Discuss the role of the World Bank Group in promoting sustainable development in developing economies like India.
question.hi: Discuss the role of the World Bank Group in promoting sustainable development in developing economies like India.

modelAnswer.en: The World Bank Group supports India through infrastructure financing (IBRD), poverty alleviation programs (IDA), and private sector growth (IFC). It provides technical expertise, policy advice, and financial support for climate resilience and human capital development.
